info.title: Unikraft Cloud Control Plane API
info.description: This specification describes the Unikraft Cloud Control Plane API, which provides mechanisms to interact with globally provided Unikraft Cloud system.

servers.description: Official Unikraft Cloud Control Plane API

get.description: Get authorization details for a token.

post.description:
Check the authorization status of a request.  The responses are streamed
back to the client, indicating whether the signin request is authorized or
not.

Initiate the sign-in process and return an authorization URL.  The user
should be redirected to this URL to complete the sign-in.

get.description:
Get one or more nodes.

Returns nodes matching the specified filters. If no filters are
provided, all nodes are returned.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return.

post.description:
Create a new node.

Creates a new compute node on the specified cloud provider. The node
will go through provisioning (PROVISIONING state) and configuration
(CONFIGURING state) before becoming ready (READY state) for use.

delete.description:
Delete one or more nodes.

Batch deletion of nodes by their identifiers.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force deletion even if nodes are in use.

patch.description:
Update one or more nodes.

Batch update of mutable properties for multiple nodes.

get.description:
List available regions for a provider.

Returns the regions available for provisioning on the specified cloud
provider, including availability zone information.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The provider to list regions for.

get.description:
List available machine types for a provider.

Returns the machine types (instance types) available for provisioning
on the specified cloud provider.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The provider to list machine types for.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Optional region filter. Some providers have region-specific availability.

get.description: Wait for multiple nodes to reach specific states.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: The desired state(s) to wait for.

parameters.name: timeout_ms
parameters.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Use -1 for infinite wait.

get.description: Get a single node by its UUID.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the node to retrieve.

delete.description:
Destroy (delete) a node by its UUID.

Deprovisions and deletes the node. The node will transition to
DEPROVISIONING state and then be removed. If the node has a delete lock,
this operation will fail unless the lock is first removed.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the node to delete.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force deletion even if the node is in use.

patch.description:
Update a node by its UUID.

Updates mutable properties of a node such as tags, delete lock,
or SSH keys.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the node to update.

get.summary: Wait for Node Node State by UUID
get.description:
Wait for a node to reach a specific state.

Blocks until the specified node reaches one of the desired states
or the timeout is reached.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the node to wait for.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description:
The desired state(s) to wait for. The request completes when any of
these states is reached.

parameters.name: timeout_ms
parameters.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Use -1 for infinite wait.

availability_zone.description:
The AWS availability zone (e.g., "us-east-1a"). If not specified, AWS
will select an availability zone within the region.

vpc_id.description:
The VPC ID where the instance will be launched. If not specified, the
default VPC for the region will be used.

subnet_id.description:
The subnet ID where the instance will be launched. If not specified,
a subnet will be selected from the VPC.

security_group_ids.description:
Security group IDs to attach to the instance. If not specified, the
default security group for the VPC will be used.

iam_instance_profile.description: The IAM instance profile ARN or name to attach to the instance.

root_volume.description:
Root EBS volume configuration. If not specified, provider defaults
will be used.

additional_volumes.description: Additional EBS volumes to attach to the instance.

dedicated_host.description:
Whether to use a dedicated host. Dedicated hosts provide visibility and
control over how instances are placed on physical servers.

placement_group.description:
Placement group name for the instance. Placement groups influence how
instances are placed on underlying hardware.

AWSConfig.description: AWSConfig contains AWS-specific configuration for node provisioning.

device_name.description:
The device name (e.g., "/dev/sda1", "/dev/xvdf"). Required for
additional volumes.

size_gib.description: Size of the volume in GiB.

volume_type.description: The volume type (gp3, gp2, io1, io2, st1, sc1, standard).

iops.description: The number of IOPS. Only valid for io1, io2, and gp3 volumes.

throughput_mibps.description: The throughput in MiB/s. Only valid for gp3 volumes.

encrypted.description: Whether the volume should be encrypted.

kms_key_id.description:
The KMS key ID for encryption. If encrypted is true and this is not
specified, the default EBS encryption key will be used.

delete_on_termination.description: Whether to delete the volume when the instance is terminated.

AWSEBSConfig.description: AWSEBSConfig defines the configuration for an AWS EBS volume.

NameOrUUID.description: An identifier for a resource.  Either a name or a UUID.

uuid.description:
The UUID of the machine.

This is a unique identifier for the machine that is generated when the
machine is created. The UUID is used to reference the machine in API calls and
can be used to identify the machine in all API calls that require a machine
identifier.

name.description:
The name of the machine.

This is a human-readable name that can be used to identify the machine.
The name must be unique within the context of your account. The name can
also be used to identify the machine in API calls.

created_at.description: The time the machine was created.

updated_at.description: The time the machine was last updated.

state.description: The current state of the machine.

state_message.example: Provisioning in progress, waiting for instance to become available
state_message.description:
An optional message providing additional information about the current
state, particularly useful for error states.

provider.description: The cloud provider where this machine is provisioned.

region.description:
The provider's region where the machine is located (e.g., "us-east-1" for
AWS, "us-central1" for GCP, "westeurope" for Azure).

machine_type.description:
The machine type as defined by the provider (e.g., "m5.xlarge" for AWS,
"n2-standard-4" for GCP, "Standard_D4s_v3" for Azure).

This determines the compute resources (CPU, memory, etc.) available on
the machine. The valid values depend on the chosen provider.

vcpus.description: The number of vCPUs available on this machine.

memory_mib.description: The amount of memory in MiB available on this machine.

ssh_keys.description: The SSH keys configured for access to this machine.

public_ipv4.description: The public IPv4 address of the machine, if assigned.

public_ipv6.description: The public IPv6 address of the machine, if assigned.

private_ipv4.description: The private IPv4 address of the machine within the provider's network.

metro.description: The Unikraft Cloud metro this machine is associated with.

provider_instance_id.description: The provider-specific instance ID or resource identifier.

provider_config.description: Provider-specific configuration that was used to provision this node.

tags.description: User-defined tags for organizing and filtering nodes.

ready_at.description: The time when the machine became ready (entered READY state).

uptime_seconds.description: The total uptime of the machine in seconds since it became ready.

delete_lock.description:
Whether the machine is protected from deletion. When true, delete operations
will fail until this is set to false.

Node.description:
Node represents a physical or virtual compute node provisioned on a
cloud provider for use as part of the Unikraft Cloud infrastructure.

Node nodes are the underlying compute resources where Unikraft Cloud
instances run.  They are provisioned on-demand across multiple cloud
providers and managed through a unified API.

hostname.description:
The hostname is the name of the machine making the request.  This is
mandatory as it consitutes a unique identifier for the machine.

os.description: The operating system of the machine making the request.

os_version.description:
The version of the operating system of the machine making the request, if
available.

For Android, it's like "10", "11", "12", etc.  For iOS and macOS it's like
"15.6.1" or "12.4.0".  For Windows it's like "10.0.19044.1889". For FreeBSD
it's like "12.3-STABLE".  For Linux, this is simply the kernel version on
Linux, like "5.10.0-17-amd64".
